correctness.rationale: The published structural theorem reduces every global optimum at length six to a representative with one side empty at levels four and five. Exhaustive integer enumeration of all remaining size recurrences gives exact maxima \(7776\), \(16807\), and \(33872\) for \(q=7,8,9\). The bundled verifier enumerates \(66148\) reduced states and independently constructs attaining codes, checking all proper-prefix/proper-suffix sets for disjointness. The finite computation is not used to infer any \(q\) outside \({7,8,9}\).

value.rationale: These are the first three alphabet sizes immediately beyond the published nonbinary length-six table, so they form a natural finite cutoff rather than an arbitrary slice. The \(q=9\) cell additionally reveals a genuine \(258\)-codeword failure of the canonical \(k=5\) Blackburn construction after equality at \(q=7\) and \(q=8\), which is structurally relevant to the fixed-length extremal problem and its eventual-optimality conjecture.
